slides.texte_overlay:
How to be a good son
as a grown man

1. Call without needing anything

Just to ask how they are.

2. Visit, and stay for dinner

Not a 20-minute drop-in.

3. Fix what you can at their place

The shelf, the light, the app.

4. Ask about their life

Before you were born.

5. Keep learning, share it

They love hearing what
you discovered.

5. Keep learning, share it

I tell them what I learned
on the Sophia app.
